title: Renewal scoring record (T-7)
description: One paying subscriber seven days before a monthly renewal. No label: the renewal is ahead. Aligns with FEATURE_COLUMNS in src/retention_radar/config.py.

renewals_completed.description: Monthly renewals already paid. 0 = this is the first renewal (the cliff).

active_days_7d.description: Days with any coding activity in the 7 days before T-7 (0-7).

active_days_28d.description: Days with any coding activity in the 28 days before T-7 (0-28).

last_active_days_ago.description: Days since the last coding activity, measured at T-7.

agent_requests_28d.description: Agent / chat requests sent to frontier models in 28 days.

allowance_used_pct.description: Share of the plan's included usage consumed in 28 days (can exceed 1 with overage).

limit_hits_14d.description: Times a 5-hour or weekly usage cap blocked a request in 14 days.

cheap_model_share_28d.description: Share of requests routed to a cheaper / auto model (rationing signal).

overage_usd_28d.description: Usage billed above the plan in 28 days (USD).

overage_toggled_off.description: 1 if paid overage was switched off or capped after being on.

suggestion_accept_rate_28d.description: Accepted / shown inline suggestions in 28 days.

accept_rate_change.description: Accept rate this 28 days / previous 28 days (1 = unchanged).

agent_task_success_rate.description: Agent tasks that ended with the change kept (not reverted) in 28 days.

failed_requests_rate.description: Share of requests that errored or timed out in 28 days.

incident_exposed_28d.description: 1 if the subscriber had requests during a declared incident window.

weekend_usage_ratio.description: Share of activity on weekends (side-project signal).

first_renewal_after_pricing_change.description: 1 if this is the subscriber's first renewal since the last limit / pricing change.
